Small data volume (~215 rows total)
2 stored procedures: secure_dml, add_job_history
2 triggers: secure_employees, update_job_history
Circular dependency between departments and employees tables
Self-referencing FK in employees table (manager_id)
3 sequences for ID generation
1 view: emp_details_view
Countries table uses Index-Organized Table (IOT)

key_findings: Selected denormalized document model for optimal CosmosDB performance
Designed 3-container architecture: employees, reference_data, audit_log
Synthetic partition key strategy prevents hot partitions (dept_{id}_{emp_id%10})
Single document read replaces 6-way Oracle join (1 RU vs 50+ RU)
Embedded job history array in employee documents eliminates separate table
Circular dependency (departments ↔ employees) resolved through phased loading
Reference data duplication acceptable due to small size (~98 documents)
Comprehensive rollback strategy defined with 3 recovery scenarios
